complaint_text: The Wi-Fi is not working in the computer laboratory
resolution: Check the network connection and restore laboratory connectivity.

resolution: Check wireless access points and network authentication services.

resolution: Inspect the network equipment and stabilize the library connection.

resolution: Inspect the desktop hardware and power supply.

complaint_text: The projector in Room 204 is not functioning
resolution: Inspect the projector and repair or replace the faulty component.

resolution: Diagnose the computer hardware and operating system.

complaint_text: The laboratory printer is not printing documents
resolution: Check printer connectivity, drivers, and hardware.

resolution: Inspect the application logs and resolve the authentication or software issue.

complaint_text: The smart classroom display is not responding
resolution: Inspect the display controller and connected equipment.

complaint_text: The network cable connection in the computer lab is unstable
resolution: Inspect the network cabling and port connections.

resolution: Verify the payment transaction and update the student account.

resolution: Review the fee record and correct the account balance.

resolution: Verify the payment receipt and reconcile the outstanding balance.

complaint_text: My scholarship amount has not been credited yet
resolution: Verify scholarship eligibility and payment status.

resolution: Check the reimbursement record and process the pending payment.

complaint_text: I was charged an incorrect examination fee
resolution: Review the examination fee calculation and correct the charge.

complaint_text: I requested a refund but have not received the amount
resolution: Check the refund request and process the pending refund.

complaint_text: The hostel fee displayed in my account is wrong
resolution: Verify the hostel fee record and correct the displayed amount.

complaint_text: My online payment failed but the amount was deducted from my bank account
resolution: Verify the transaction and coordinate the refund or payment reconciliation.

complaint_text: The finance office has not updated my latest fee payment
resolution: Verify the payment record and update the student finance account.

resolution: Inspect the fan motor and electrical connection.

resolution: Investigate the situation and increase security monitoring.
